verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a compliance SaaS with built-in AI features (an AI Editor for ingestion workflows, AI evidence validation), so letting its AI consume external MCP servers is a fair question. The evidence pack never mentions MCP client support or any way to connect external tool servers. Its integrations, webhooks and APIs are conventional connectors, and the compliance-skills repo is a set of skills for external coding agents, not MCP client capability within Sprinto.
